title: Los Angeles weather: Southern California braces for Halloween rain. Here's what to expect this weekend - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Southern California rain to taper off Sunday ahead of weeklong sunshine, mild temperatures - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal rain to taper off Sunday ahead of weeklong sunshine, mild temperatures 
 Rainy conditions are expected to taper off across Southern California on Sunday ahead of a week marked by sunshine and mild temperatures. Sunday, November 1, 2026 8:37AM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Rainy conditions are expected to taper off across Southern California on Sunday ahead of a week marked by sunshine and mild temperatures.
 In Los Angeles and Orange County, look for a 70% chance of showers and a high of 68 degrees. The low will be 56.
 A 50% chance of rain is on tap for the valleys and the Inland Empire, where the high temperature will rise to 71. The low will be 52 degrees.
 The beaches, mountains and desert areas can also expect a 50% chance of showers, with a high of 70 degrees and a low temperature of 58 along the coast.
 The mountain areas will see a high of 48 degrees and a low temperature of 29.
 The deserts can expect a high temperature of 64 degrees and a low of 38.
 The storm is expected to clear out of the region by Monday, when temperatures will slightly rise amid sunny skies that will last throughout the week.
